name: ZCode

form_factor.comment: Unified ZCode product with terminal, desktop ADE, local browser, and mobile Remote Control surfaces. The official repository documents `zcode`, `zcode --web`, and `zcode --prompt`, but the release publishes desktop installers rather than a separately installable CLI package. Per-form-factor links: CLI: https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode#cli-source-development; IDE: https://zcode.z.ai/en; Desktop App: https://zcode.z.ai/en/docs/install; Web: https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode#setup; Mobile: https://zcode.z.ai/en/docs/remote-control.

released_in.comment: Public ZCode docs and desktop downloads are live in 2026; exact public launch date not confirmed in accessible docs.

latest_major_update.comment: ZCode 3.14.3 shipped September 22, 2026 with adjustable workflow concurrency, improved workflow restart and script-submission behavior, better large-workflow status, lower workflow context and token use, and workflow and interface reliability fixes.

rules.comment: Reads user global `~/.zcode/AGENTS.md` and workspace `AGENTS.md`; workspace instructions are primary and CLAUDE.md is only a one-time onboarding migration source.

skills.comment: First-class `SKILL.md` skills under `~/.zcode/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md`, with Settings management and import from other agents.

hooks.comment: ZCode documents a local subprocess hook protocol with session, model, tool, and stop events, JSON stdin and stdout contracts, exit-code behavior, user configuration, plugin packaging, and explicit trust controls.

mcp_servers.comment: Supports stdio, HTTP, and SSE MCP servers, full JSON config import, env vars/headers, plugin MCP servers, and importing MCP config from Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, and `.agents`.

custom_commands.comment: User/workspace custom slash commands can be created in settings and invoked from `/` in ZCode Agent.

goal_command.comment: Built-in `/goal` supports set, replace, pause, resume, and clear; the agent automatically verifies each round and continues until the goal is complete.

subagents.comment: Built-in, custom, and workflow-orchestrated subagents are supported. Dynamic workflows can coordinate multiple subagents from one script, while custom agents support their own model, tool permissions, and instructions.

monitor.comment: ZCode has built-in/custom subagents and workspace task surfaces, but reviewed docs do not show a dedicated command/log/WebSocket Monitor-equivalent.

model_selection.comment: Model selector and model settings support Z.ai, BigModel, GLM Coding Plan, and API-key providers.

approval_mode.comment: Execution modes include Default, Confirm Before Changes, and Auto Edit; safety confirmation pauses risky actions for approval.

sandbox_mode.comment: Remote development can run workspaces in SSH hosts or local Docker containers; no standalone local sandbox flag is documented.

resume.comment: The official ZCode CLI defines `--resume <session>` and uses the requested session for both terminal and headless prompt runs.

continue.comment: The official ZCode CLI defines `-c` and `--continue` to continue the latest applicable session, including with headless prompt runs.

non_interactive.comment: The official unified command includes headless `zcode --prompt` execution in addition to the terminal UI and local Web interface.

output_format.comment: Headless prompt runs accept `--json` and `--output-format`, including text, JSON, and streaming JSON event output.

statusline.comment: Goal summary panel shows status, elapsed time, tokens, and iteration count, but no custom statusline API is documented.

telemetry.comment: Usage Stats exists; no telemetry opt-out/control docs found.

custom_model_provider.comment: Supports third-party compatible model services through Anthropic/OpenAI protocols and API key mode.

pricing.value: 5-day free trial quota; GLM Coding Lite $12.60/mo ($18 list), Pro $56/mo ($80 list), Max $117.60/mo ($168 list); weekly credit limits; API/resource package billing also available
pricing.comment: ZCode lists current GLM Coding Plan promotional and list prices, weekly credit allowances, and plan multipliers. ZCode docs also document a five-day new-user trial and API or resource-package billing paths.

some_free_usage.comment: First-time ZCode users receive a 5-day free trial with daily GLM-5.3 and GLM-5-turbo token benefits; subscribers can also run gradually rolling-out idle-time tasks without consuming plan quota.

hosted_agent.comment: Runtime remains the desktop workspace or remote SSH/Docker target; mobile remote only controls the open desktop workspace.

transcripts.comment: Task list/conversation history is first-class in the desktop UI, but public docs do not expose disk transcript paths.

transcript_location.value: Desktop task/conversation history; exact path undocumented
transcript_location.comment: Task list/conversation history is first-class in the desktop UI, but public docs do not expose disk transcript paths.

keyboard_shortcuts.comment: ZCode 3.14.0 added keyboard-shortcut settings that record custom key combinations and apply them immediately; Command Center also exposes shortcut-driven actions.

auto_save.comment: Research needed. Public docs did not expose enough detail in this run.

debugging_output.comment: Log export exists and was improved in v3.2.2; public docs do not expose a full debug/verbose mode.

context_window.comment: ZCode is deeply integrated with GLM-5.3's stable 1M-token context for long-horizon coding; custom-provider windows are editable while Coding Plan built-in windows are server-managed.

code_formatting.comment: Research needed. Public docs did not expose enough detail in this run.

git_integration.comment: ZCode Agent understands Git branch state and combines workspace state, tool results, and Git changes during tasks.

performance_mode.comment: Execution modes and model selector can trade off confirmation/autonomy and model choice, but no named performance mode is documented.

ui_customization.comment: Desktop UI supports interface scaling and theme switching; deeper layout customization is not documented.

notes: Z.ai/Zhipu's official GLM-5.3 harness is one unified ZCode product with desktop, browser, terminal, and mobile-control interfaces. Its official repository includes an Agent CLI with headless prompt, resume, continue, and structured-output flags. No distinct official GLM Coding CLI or GLM Code product was found, and the current release assets provide desktop installers rather than a standalone CLI installer, so no agent-launch backend was added.
